views.text: In October 2026, a guest on Equity Mates described APA Group as exceptional and one of the largest holdings in an infrastructure portfolio, highlighting it as a high quality Australian operator.

episode.title: The Infrastructure Behind AI, Electrification and Energy Security with Shane Hurst

views.text: In March 2021, Equity Mates listed APA Group among ASX infrastructure companies, noting it as a way to get exposure to essential assets alongside names like Transurban and Sydney Airport.

episode.title: EM Chat: Industry Deep Dive - Infrastructure

views.text: In October 2026, a guest on Equity Mates said contracting and regulation limited the impact of build delays and cost increases and, after speaking with APA’s CEO, flagged NIMBYism as a growing approvals risk overseas that had not really emerged in Australia.
